{{Quote|Sir, I'm here to fight in the Scarlet Dawn.|A pilot, to [[Dartas Pytin]]|<ref name="SWG:PM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Precise Maneuvers|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
The '''Scarlet Dawn''' was a quadrant of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]],<ref name="SWG:PM" /> in the shadow of the [[Sanguinus Veil Nebula]].<ref name="SWG:PBJR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Patrol: Bright Jewel Ribbon|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Scarlet Dawn was controlled by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] pirates and was the most dangerous quadrant of the Bright Jewel system.<ref name="SWG:PM" /> It contained the [[Salient Trinity]], that consisted of the [[Darkveil Eclipse]] and the [[Dual Moons]], the three Black Sun [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] bases in the system.<ref name="SWG:AtT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|After the Trinity|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> The Trinity was attacked by [[Dartas Pytin]]'s Car'das starfighters during the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]].<ref name="SWG:AtT" /><ref name="SWG:DE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Darkveil Eclipse|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>
